ficha_publicada.poderes: The Emerald Eye of Ekron (Removable, –18 points, Indestructible, +1 point): Emerald Blast (Ranged Damage 18), Levitation (Flight 5 (60 MPH)), Protective Field (Impervious Protection 18; Immunity 10: Life Support)
ficha_publicada.pericias: Deception 4 (+8), Insight 4 (+7), Intimidation 4(+8), Perception 4 (+7), Persuasion 4 (+8), Ranged Combat: Emerald Eye 4 (+6)
ficha_publicada.ataques: Initiative +2, Emerald Blast +10 (Ranged, Damage 18), Unarmed +1 (Close, Damage 0)
ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Blind and Powerless: Blinding the Emerald Eye leaves the Empress unable to access its powers. Kryptonite: Exposure to kryptonite can reduce the Emerald Eye’s power ranks and even disable it for a time.
